content.title: Total Behaviors

content.query:
SentinelBehaviorEntities
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start} and TimeGenerated <= {TimeRange:end}
| where isnotempty(EntityType)
| extend EntityValue = coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalIP, ServiceSource, FileName, Application, RemoteUrl, CloudResourceId)
| where isnotempty(EntityValue)
| summarize ActiveEntities = dcount(EntityValue)
content.title: Active Entities

content.query:
SentinelBehaviorInfo
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start} and TimeGenerated <= {TimeRange:end}
| where isnotempty(Categories)
| extend CategoriesArray = parse_json(Categories)
| mv-expand Category = CategoriesArray to typeof(string)
| summarize UniqueTactics = dcount(Category)
content.title: Unique Tactics

content.query:
SentinelBehaviorInfo
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start} and TimeGenerated <= {TimeRange:end}
| summarize BehaviorCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Behavior Timeline Trend

content.query:
SentinelBehaviorInfo
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start} and TimeGenerated <= {TimeRange:end}
| where isnotempty(Categories)
| extend CategoriesArray = parse_json(Categories)
| mv-expand Category = CategoriesArray to typeof(string)
| summarize BehaviorCount = count(), DistinctBehaviors = dcount(BehaviorId) by Category
| order by BehaviorCount desc

# Entities Investigation
Deep-dive into incidents and entity behaviors. Select an incident to analyze behaviors before, during, and after the event.

Paste below your entities of interest from an incident and choose the time range you would like to investigate.

parameters.name: IncidentEntities
parameters.label: Incident Entities
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of entity values from the selected incident

content.query:
let incidentEntities = dynamic([{IncidentEntities}]);
let incidentTime = todatetime("{IncidentTime}");
let windowBefore = totimespan('{WindowBefore}');
let windowAfter = totimespan('{WindowAfter}');
SentinelBehaviorEntities
| where TimeGenerated between ((incidentTime - windowBefore) .. (incidentTime + windowAfter))
| where isnotempty(EntityType)
| extend EntityValue = coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalIP, FileName, Application, RemoteUrl, CloudResourceId)
| where EntityValue in (incidentEntities)
| join kind=inner (
    SentinelBehaviorInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between ((incidentTime - windowBefore) .. (incidentTime + windowAfter))
    | project BehaviorId, Title, Description, Categories, AttackTechniques, StartTime, EndTime
) on BehaviorId
| extend TimeRelativeToIncident = iff(TimeGenerated < incidentTime, "Before", iff(TimeGenerated > incidentTime, "After", "During"))
| project TimeGenerated, TimeRelativeToIncident, EntityType, EntityValue, EntityRole, Title, Description, Categories, AttackTechniques
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Behavior Timeline (Before/During/After Incident)

content.query:
let incidentEntities = dynamic([{IncidentEntities}]);
SentinelBehaviorEntities
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start} and TimeGenerated <= {TimeRange:end}
| where isnotempty(EntityType)
| extend EntityValue = coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalIP, FileName, Application, RemoteUrl, CloudResourceId)
| where EntityValue in (incidentEntities)
| join kind=inner (
    SentinelBehaviorInfo
    | where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start} and TimeGenerated <= {TimeRange:end}
    | project BehaviorId, Title, Categories, AttackTechniques
) on BehaviorId
| summarize 
    BehaviorCount = dcount(BehaviorId),
    BehaviorTypes = make_set(Title),
    Roles = make_set(EntityRole),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by EntityType, EntityValue
| extend BehaviorTypeCount = array_length(BehaviorTypes)
| project EntityType, EntityValue, BehaviorCount, BehaviorTypeCount, Roles, FirstSeen, LastSeen, BehaviorTypes
| order by BehaviorCount desc
content.title: Entity Behavior Summary

# Hunting and Discovery
Proactive threat hunting capabilities to discover interesting activity in your environment.

content.query:
SentinelBehaviorInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Count = count() by Title
| order by Count asc
| take 20
content.title: Rarest Behaviors (7 days lookback)

content.query:
SentinelBehaviorEntities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(EntityType)
| where EntityType != "Ip"
| extend EntityValue = coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, ServiceSource, FileName, Application, RemoteUrl, CloudResourceId)
| where isnotempty(EntityValue)
| where EntityValue !startswith "System."
| join kind=inner (
    SentinelBehaviorInfo 
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | extend CategoriesArray = parse_json(Categories)
    | extend TechniquesArray = parse_json(AttackTechniques)
    | extend TitleArray = parse_json(Title)
    | mv-expand Category = CategoriesArray to typeof(string)
    | mv-expand Technique = TechniquesArray to typeof(string)
    | mv-expand Title = TitleArray to typeof(string)
) on BehaviorId
| summarize 
    DistinctTactics = dcount(Category),
    Tactics = make_set(Category),
    Techniques = make_set(Technique),
    Titles = make_set(Title)
    by EntityType, EntityValue
| where DistinctTactics >= 3
| project EntityType, EntityValue, TacticCount = DistinctTactics, Tactics, Techniques, Titles
| order by TacticCount desc
//| take 20
content.title: Attack Chain Detector (≥3 Tactics, 24H lookback)

content.query:
let today = startofday(now());
let weekAgo = today - 7d;
let todayActivity = SentinelBehaviorEntities
| where TimeGenerated >= today
| where isnotempty(EntityType)
| where EntityType != "Ip"
| extend EntityValue = coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, FileName, Application, RemoteUrl, CloudResourceId)
| where isnotempty(EntityValue)
| where EntityValue !startswith "System."
| summarize TodayCount = count() by EntityType, EntityValue;
let historicalActivity = SentinelBehaviorEntities
| where TimeGenerated >= weekAgo and TimeGenerated < today
| where isnotempty(EntityType)
| where EntityType != "Ip"
| extend EntityValue = coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, FileName, Application, RemoteUrl, CloudResourceId)
| where isnotempty(EntityValue)
|  summarize TotalHistorical = count() by EntityType, EntityValue
| extend DailyAverage = TotalHistorical / 7.0;
todayActivity
| join kind=inner historicalActivity on EntityType, EntityValue
| extend VelocityRatio = TodayCount / DailyAverage
//| where VelocityRatio > 2.0
| project EntityType, EntityValue, TodayCount, DailyAverage = round(DailyAverage, 2), VelocityRatio = round(VelocityRatio, 2)
| order by VelocityRatio desc
| take 20
content.title: Entity Velocity Tracker (>200% Increase, 7 days)

content.query:
let today = startofday(now());
let weekAgo = today - 7d;
let todayActivity = SentinelBehaviorInfo
| where TimeGenerated >= today
| where isnotempty(Description)
| summarize TodayCount = count() by Description;
let historicalActivity = SentinelBehaviorInfo
| where TimeGenerated >= weekAgo and TimeGenerated < today
| where isnotempty(Description)
| summarize TotalHistorical = count() by Description
| extend DailyAverage = TotalHistorical / 7.0;
todayActivity
| join kind=inner historicalActivity on Description
| extend VelocityRatio = TodayCount / DailyAverage
| where VelocityRatio > 2.0
| project Description, TodayCount, DailyAverage = round(DailyAverage, 2), VelocityRatio = round(VelocityRatio, 2)
| order by VelocityRatio desc
| take 20
content.title: Behavior Velocity Tracker (>200% Increase)
